functions.name: CreateAbbreviatedNumberFormatter
documentation: Creates a numeric formatter that converts numbers to abbreviated strings, eg. 123456 -> '123k'.

functions.name: CreateNumericRuleFormatter
documentation: Creates a numeric formatter that converts numbers to strings with flexible rulesets.

functions.name: CreateSecondsFormatter
documentation: Creates a numeric formatter that converts numbers measuring durations in seconds to strings, eg. 93 -> '1m 33s'.

functions.name: EscapeDecimalNonPrintables
documentation:
Returns a string with ASCII control characters (except 
, , and 	) and invalid UTF-8 bytes replaced by decimal escape sequences (e.g. \127).

functions.name: EscapeLuaFormatString
documentation: Returns a string with Lua format string tokens ('%') escaped.

functions.name: EscapeLuaPatterns
documentation: Returns a string with all Lua pattern characters escaped.

functions.name: EscapeQuotedCodes
documentation: Returns a string with all quoted code sequences ('|' characters) escaped.

functions.name: RemoveContiguousSpaces
documentation: Returns a string with all contiguous occurrences of ASCII space characters truncated.

arguments.name: maxAllowedSpaces
documentation: Maximum number of permitted contiguous space characters; excessive spaces will be truncated to this count.

arguments.name: maintainColor
documentation: If true, preserve all '|c' and '|r' quoted code sequences.

arguments.name: maintainBrackets
documentation: If true, preserve all '[' and ']' characters.

arguments.name: stripNewlines
documentation: If true, remove all '|n' quoted code sequences.

arguments.name: maintainAtlases
documentation: If true, preserve all balanced '|A' and '|a' quoted code sequences.

arguments.name: maintainTextures
documentation: If true, preserve all balanced '|T' and '|t' quoted code sequences.

functions.name: TruncateWhenZero
documentation: Formats the given number to a string as an integer (rounding down). If the integer is zero, returns an empty string.

functions.name: WrapString
documentation: Returns a string with 'prefix' and 'suffix' joined to 'infix' iif 'infix' is not an empty string. Else, an empty string is returned.
